candidates.scope: Modular washer/extractor, heat-pump dryer, measured fibre/water treatment and finishing modules.
candidates.safety_boundary: Household appliance water/electrical/thermal safety; modules preserve appliance safety case.

candidates.scope: Hanger-based steam/air refresh, dehumidification, wrinkle relaxation and local filtration; not soil removal.
candidates.safety_boundary: Steam/heat/electrical protection and garment compatibility; no stain-removal or dry-clean claim.

candidates.scope: Vision-assisted bounded stain mapping with approved micro-dose chemistry, local extraction and human review.
candidates.safety_boundary: Approved chemistry, local extraction, exposure control, compatibility and abstention on uncertain fibres/dyes.

candidates.scope: Professional aqueous delicate-garment cleaning with controlled mechanics, moisture-managed drying and tension/steam finishing.
candidates.safety_boundary: Professional wet-clean equipment, trained operation, water/waste controls and garment-family qualification.

candidates.scope: Closed-loop liquid-CO2 cleaning with filtration and supplier-engineered recovery for validated garment classes.
candidates.safety_boundary: Qualified pressure-system engineering, relief, leak/asphyxiation controls, ventilation and supplier-certified equipment.

candidates.scope: Media-specific sealed solvent cleaning; each solvent family has dedicated compatibility, recovery, waste and recipes.
candidates.safety_boundary: Solvent-specific fire/explosion, exposure, ventilation, recovery, emissions and hazardous-waste controls.

candidates.scope: Garment identity, care-label capture, inspection, stain mapping, material uncertainty, separation and route suggestion with abstention.
candidates.safety_boundary: Privacy-preserving local imaging, human approval and no automatic process selection for unknown materials.

candidates.scope: Tracked batch/rail handling for uniforms, hospitality and workwear with scheduling, finishing and garment lineage.
candidates.safety_boundary: Industrial guarding, material segregation, hygiene/PPE validation, worker protection and site environmental controls.
